# Command reference

Every operation in this area, as a `metorial-admin` CLI command and as a tool on the Metorial admin MCP server (`mcp.metorial.com/mcp`). API version: `mt_2026_01_01_magnetar`. 28 CLI commands, 28 MCP tools.

- **CLI**: prefix with `metorial-admin`. Run `metorial-admin <command> --help` for every flag. Write commands also accept `--body` or `--body-file` with a JSON object.
- **MCP tool**: pass inputs in snake_case (`<provider-id>` → `provider_id`). Instance-scoped tools also accept an optional `instance_id`.
- **Effect**: `read` changes nothing; `write` creates or changes something; `destructive` deletes, revokes, archives, or runs code. Confirm destructive actions with the user first.
- **—** in a column means that interface has no equivalent. Use the alternative named in the summary, or call the API path with `metorial-admin fetch` / the `call_endpoint` tool.

## callbacks

| CLI command | MCP tool | Effect | Summary | Required inputs | API |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `callbacks create` | `callbacks_create` | write | Create callback | --integration-id --integration-provider-id | `POST /callbacks` |
| `callbacks delete <callback-id>` | `callbacks_delete` | destructive | Delete callback | <callback-id> | `DELETE /callbacks/:callbackId` |
| `callbacks get <callback-id>` | `callbacks_get` | read | Get callback | <callback-id> | `GET /callbacks/:callbackId` |
| `callbacks list` | `callbacks_list` | read | List callbacks |  | `GET /callbacks` |
| `callbacks update <callback-id>` | `callbacks_update` | write | Update callback | <callback-id> | `PATCH /callbacks/:callbackId` |
